checks.explanation: The predicted 2022-2023 funding winter did materialize: startup shutdowns tracked by Carta jumped from 467 in 2022 to 770 in 2023 (a record), global VC funding fell 38% year-over-year to $285B in 2023, and roughly 3,200 startups representing $27.2B in prior funding folded.

sources.title: 2023 was an 'extinction' level year for tech startups | CNN Business
Startup Shutdowns Reach New Heights as Funding Crunch Bites

checks.explanation: The predicted 10-year window runs through roughly 2032 and hasn't elapsed yet; while VR fidelity has improved substantially, no consumer headset has yet demonstrated a 'perfectly simulate a fluorescent-lit conference room' level of fidelity as of 2026.
